notes.title: Melon Knight: New Free DLC is OUT!
notes.notes:
We've worked hard to create this free DLC, it showcases the story before the events of the main game. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/0d5df96ae7967256c13bb38a76c7aa9309ce4437.png[/img]


'Stubborn Pumpkin' is a story + a series of mini games + a new boss fight. Hope you'll have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/cb94c1e8b1874d4ba5dc2fc00e30b9f81f270d97.png[/img]

Enjoy! :)
Boss Crab Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/b37d74d88b7430d603aaceeaa33cd9cc664e1338.png[/img]

notes.title: Just FIVE days till RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hey PPL! 
How is it going?
It's been a long way for us, the way of given up on Gamedev and goin back in.
But now we're finally on the path to our first release on Steam.
We're are a team of two brothers living the dream of indie game development! Let's gooo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/aa8e887cb2b7df022678bc998061ab6c32bb258e.gif[/img]

We're hoping you'll enjoy this small adventure full of monsters, boss fights and rewards!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/b37d74d88b7430d603aaceeaa33cd9cc664e1338.png[/img]

Have fun! ;)

Boss Crab Games Team
